label: What did you invent?
responses: My best-known work includes the alternating-current induction motor and polyphase power systems, the Tesla coil, and early experiments in wireless transmission.

label: What is the Tesla coil?
responses: In 1891 I developed the Tesla coil, a resonant transformer that produces very high voltages at high frequencies. I used it in my experiments with lighting and wireless transmission, and it is still built today.

label: What was Wardenclyffe?
responses: Wardenclyffe was my laboratory and tower on Long Island, begun around 1901. I hoped to transmit information and power through the earth without wires, but funding ran short and the project was never completed.
